command:
set -eu
sed -i --follow-symlinks 's|http://cdn\.opensuse\.org/|https://cdn.opensuse.org/|g' /etc/zypp/repos.d/*.repo /usr/share/zypp/local/service/openSUSE/repo/repoindex.xml
zypper --non-interactive install --no-recommends python3 ca-certificates shadow util-linux findutils createrepo_c gpg2
exec python3 -B -W error /tools/qualify-installed.py /manifest.json --repository-install --core-lifecycle --output /results/qualification
